title: Master in Law and Governance
about: Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) in Morocco lists its Master in Law and Governance for a September 2027 start. Applications go through the UM6P online portal and close on 31 March 2027.
requirements: Online application: create a candidate account, complete details and upload documents, submit before the deadline
